title: Change Blindness: Why You Miss Big Changes Right in Front of You
excerpt: Two classic studies, a flicker test and a stranger swapped behind a door, show how often large changes go unseen. What they found, what they did not, and a demo to try.

meta.advanced_seo_description: Change blindness explained from the original studies: the flicker test, the door experiment where half missed a swapped stranger, and an interactive demo.
